400.description: CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH (a prediction contest: a bracket, a pick'em pool and a survivor pool have their own leaderboards, getBracketLeaderboard, getPickEmLeaderboard and getSurvivorLeaderboard), CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST (the asked-for event is not one the contest covers), CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_PICKS_HIDDEN (no event's picks are revealed yet, or not the asked-for one's), _EVENT_REQUIRED, _COUNTING_RULE_MISSING, _SCORING_RULE_MISSING (the configuration carries no participant scoring rule), _SCORING_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN (its rule names a definition the registry does not know) or _SCORING_SETTINGS_INVALID (its rule's settings are not valid for that definition).

get.description: Returns a bracket contest's leaderboard (#721): each entry that submitted its bracket, with its points so far (a correct pick earns its round's value plus any upset bonus, under the contest's knockout round points), the most it can still reach (its points plus the round value of every pick whose team is still in), and its place. Entries level on points are ordered, once the final is played, by how close their tiebreaker was to the final's total points; entries still level share a place. Available once the event has started and picks are revealed. Once the contest is COMPLETED, points and places come from the standings frozen at settlement, so a later result correction does not change a settled place. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

400.description: CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH (not a bracket contest), CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_PICKS_HIDDEN (the event has not started), or CONTEST_LEADERBOARD_SCORING_RULE_MISSING, _SCORING_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN (its rule is not knockout round points) or _SCORING_SETTINGS_INVALID.

get.description: Returns a pick'em contest's season leaderboard (#717): each entry that submitted at least one week, with its season total and, for each week, its points and place. A correct pick earns 1 point straight up, or its confidence value in a confidence pool; a pick on a lost game, a tie or a cancelled game earns nothing, and a week still in draft at its first kickoff scores nothing. Entries level on a week's points are ordered, once the week's last game is played, by how close their tiebreaker was to that game's total points; entries still level share the place. A week under way is scored live from its played games. Once a week settles, its points and places are frozen and its first-place entries are its winners; a later result correction changes nothing. Once the contest is COMPLETED, the season totals and places come from the standings frozen at settlement. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: A pick'em contest's season leaderboard: the season total, each week's points and places, and the weekly winners.

get.description: Returns a survivor contest's leaderboard (#719): each entry that submitted at least one week, whether it is still in or the week that put it out, and its weeks survived. An entry picks one team a week, each team once a season; it survives the week when that team wins or its game is cancelled, and goes out after a loss, a tie, or a week not submitted by its first kickoff. A cancelled week counts for nothing. Entries still in come first, then by weeks survived; entries out in the same week share a place. Each week shows the entry's outcome and, once its game has kicked off, the team it picked. Read live from the results; once the contest is COMPLETED, the places come from the standings frozen at settlement. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

200.description: A survivor contest's leaderboard: who is still in, and when each entry went out.

post.summary: Create the current user contest entry
post.description: Creates a new contest entry for the authenticated user. This route never returns an existing entry; clients should use the GET entry endpoints to inspect current entry state before or after creation. Entries change only while the contest is OPEN and before its event's scheduled start: 400 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise. Acting for a squad needs an ACTIVE league membership and an ACTIVE squad membership: 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, or SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED when the caller has no squad. 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LIMIT_REACHED when the squad holds the contest's most entries per squad, and 409 CONTEST_FULL when the contest holds its league plan's entries per contest (#947), drafts included; entries already in stay and stay editable.

delete.summary: Delete the current user contest entry
delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user contest entry when the contest rules still allow the user to leave the contest: the contest is OPEN, its event has not reached its scheduled start, and the entry has no picks. Acting for a squad needs an ACTIVE league membership and an ACTIVE squad membership: 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE, or SQUAD_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED when the caller has no squad.

get.description: The league's sports league cups of one season, oldest first: one per sports league the league has a contest of that season in, each with its standings and its contests. Standings are worked out from the contests' frozen places: a squad scores from its best entry on the league's points table, times each contest's weight. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_STANDINGS, PAST_YEARS for a year before the current one (root admins too).

parameters.name: seasonYear
parameters.description: The season whose cups to list, such as 2026.

get.description: The seasons in which the league has a contest a cup lists (drafts left out), newest first: with the championship's years, the years the Championships page offers. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_STANDINGS, PAST_YEARS (root admins too).

200.description: The seasons in which a league has cups.

get.description: One squad's points in the league's cup for a season and sports league, counted contest by counted contest, in the order they went final, with the cup's id and name. 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND when the league has no cup for that season and sports league, SQUAD_NOT_FOUND for a squad that is not the league's. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_STANDINGS, PAST_YEARS for a year before the current one (root admins too).

parameters.name: seasonYear
parameters.description: The cup's season, such as 2026.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: The cup's sports league.

get.description: One cup with its standings and contests: the Points race. 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND for a cup that is not the league's. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_STANDINGS (root admins too).

get.summary: Project a cup from its live contests
get.description: An open cup's standings if every live contest it counts ended now: each scores from its leaderboard's places as they stand, at its own weight, on top of the contests already counted. A live contest whose picks are not revealed yet, or a squares contest, ranks nobody. Nothing is stored. 409 CUP_CROWNED for a crowned cup, whose standings are final; 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND for a cup that is not the league's. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_STANDINGS (root admins too).

post.summary: Crown a cup
post.description: Allows a commissioner to crown a cup once its season is done: every squad's place is frozen with the points table it was scored on, and the squads 1st, 2nd and 3rd with points take its trophies, ties sharing. A contest that goes final later is listed AFTER_CROWNING and changes nothing. 409 CUP_HAS_UNFINISHED_CONTESTS while a counted contest is open or live, its `details.contests` listing each (`contestId`, `name`, `status`); 409 CUP_NOTHING_COUNTED before any contest has counted toward it; 409 CUP_CROWNED for a cup already crowned; 404 CUP_NOT_FOUND for a cup that is not the league's. Active commissioners only (root admins bypass). 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CUP_CROWNING (root admins too).

get.description: Every year the league has a counted contest in, newest first, with the squads in 1st: the champions of a year that is over, the leaders of the current one. Years with no counted contest are left out. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CHAMPIONSHIP, PAST_YEARS (root admins too).

One year of the league championship: every counted contest of every sport that went final in the calendar year (US Eastern), each squad scoring from its best entry with the points it earned at settlement. Standings with the finish matrix, and the medal tiles. A year with no counted contest answers every active squad at 0. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has CHAMPIONSHIP, PAST_YEARS for a year before the current one (root admins too).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The championship year, such as 2026.

get.summary: Get last year's year in review
get.description: Where the league's year in review for last year (US Eastern) stands: NOTHING_TO_SEND when no championship contest counted that year, READY from 1 January until the commissioner sends it, then SENT with when and by whom. The "ready to send" banner and the Send button read it. Active commissioners only (root admins bypass). 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has EMAIL_YEAR_IN_REVIEW (root admins too).

200.description: Where the league's year in review for last year stands.

post.summary: Send the year in review
post.description: Allows a commissioner to send last year's year in review: each active owner of an active squad that placed that year gets an email with their squad's year (championship place and points, contest 1sts, 2nds and 3rds, the cups it placed in, its trophies) and a link to its squad page for that year. Owners who turned off Results email are skipped. Sent once per league and year. 409 YEAR_REVIEW_NOT_OPEN for any year but last year; 409 YEAR_REVIEW_NOTHING_TO_SEND when no championship contest counted that year; 409 YEAR_REVIEW_ALREADY_SENT once it is sent. Active commissioners only (root admins bypass). 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has EMAIL_YEAR_IN_REVIEW (root admins too).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The year whose review to send, such as 2026: only last year can be sent.

200.description: Where the league's year in review for last year stands.

get.description: Every year the league has a counted championship contest or a cup in, newest first: the championship's champions (its leaders for the current year) and each cup of that season with its champions (its leaders while open). Tiles for the most championships won (years over only) and the most cups won (crowned cups only), ties naming every squad. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has ALL_TIME_SUMMARY (root admins too).

The league's perpetual trophies, worked out on read: one for each contest of one event it has run in two or more years, on the same slot definitions and the same way of picking (by template from #2024), with a plate per year naming its 1st place squads (none for a contest that went final with nobody placed). A week of games (several games, one round, none sending its winner on, such as an NFL regular-season week) earns none, and contests not counted are left out. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has TROPHY_SHELF (root admins too).

The league's record book, worked out on read from its counted contest finishes and its championships of years over: most championships, the longest run of championships in consecutive years, most contest wins in a year and of all time, the longest run of contests on the podium, and the biggest field won; then the Hall of Lame (most 2nds, 4ths and last places, the longest drought), unless the league hides it. Each names every holder on a tie and the next best. Contests not counted and cancelled ones are left out. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has RECORD_BOOK (root admins too).

A squad's whole history for its squad page: its contest medals all time (its championship rows' 1sts, 2nds and 3rds summed over every year), its trophy shelf (league championships finished 1st to 3rd in years that are over, and crowned cups' trophies), and its year, as `getSquadYear` reads it, for every year the league has a championship or a cup season in, newest first. A league whose plan lacks PAST_YEARS gets only the current year; each year's championship row is null without CHAMPIONSHIP, and its cup rows empty without CUP_STANDINGS. A squad of another league is 404 SQUAD_NOT_FOUND. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has TROPHY_SHELF (root admins too).

200.description: A squad's whole history in the league.

get.description: One squad's year for its squad page: its row of the league championship (place, points, gap to 1st, movement, finish matrix row) and its row of each cup of the season with that year, read through the same services as the Championship and Points race tabs. Its contests are `listContestResults` with its squadId. The championship row is null while the league's plan lacks CHAMPIONSHIP, and the cup rows empty while it lacks CUP_STANDINGS. A squad of another league is 404 SQUAD_NOT_FOUND. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. 403 PLAN_FEATURE_NOT_INCLUDED, its `details.feature` naming what is missing, unless the league's plan has PAST_YEARS for a year before the current one (root admins too).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The championship year, US Eastern, such as 2026; the cups read are the season with this year.

get.description: Every contest of the league that went final in the championship year (US Eastern), newest first, with its winners and whether it counted. With squadId, only the counted contests that squad placed in; with squadId and place, only those it finished in that place, so each list matches the finish matrix. With finishOf, each contest carries that squad's finish (its place, from its best entry) without the list narrowing: Contests > Past shows the viewer's team's place this way (#1570). With finishedSince, only the contests that went final at or after it: League Home's last few days of finals (#1782). No paging: a league finishes a few hundred contests a year at most. Active members of the league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The championship year, US Eastern, the contests went final in, such as 2026.

parameters.name: squadId
parameters.description: Only the counted contests this squad placed in: its Played count.

parameters.name: place
parameters.description: With squadId, only the counted contests the squad finished in this place: its matrix cell. Refused without squadId (400 SQUAD_ID_REQUIRED).

parameters.name: finishedSince
parameters.description: Only the contests that went final at or after this instant, within the year (#1782): League Home lists the last few days' finals without reading the whole year.

parameters.name: finishOf
parameters.description: The squad whose finish each listed contest carries in squadFinish, without narrowing the list (#1570): any finish of its in the contest, counted or not. Defaults to squadId. A squad outside the league is 404 SQUAD_NOT_FOUND.

get.description: The seeded configurations a contest can be created from. Anyone may read them, signed in or not: they are product copy shown on the public How to Play page. Every filter is optional; the create flow asks for the chosen event's sport league's active templates (every template is one league's) covering one of the event's slot definitions.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: Only this sport league's templates; never another league's. Omitted: every template regardless of league. The create flow passes the chosen event's sport league.

parameters.name: slotDefinitionIds
parameters.description: Only templates covering one of these slot definitions (#2010): repeat the parameter for several. The create flow passes the chosen event's (SportEventDto.slotDefinitionIds).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Only active (true) or inactive (false) templates. Omitted: both. The create flow asks for active ones.

200.description: Available seeded contest templates for commissioner create flow.

put.description: Updates a seeded template that future contests are created from. Root admin only (403 ROOT_ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED otherwise); contests already created from it keep their own configuration. A configuration must be the template's own selection type's rules (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_RULES_MISMATCH otherwise). The slots it lists must be its own sport league's (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN_SLOT), all in one competition for ALL_LISTED and FROM_SLOT, since no contest crosses competitions (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_SPANS_COMPETITIONS), and fit its coverage: ALL_LISTED lists one event's slots (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_ALL_LISTED_SPANS_EVENTS), and a bracket only knockout slots (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_BRACKET_OUTSIDE_KNOCKOUT). A template scored by knockout round points that covers all its listed slots gives one round value for each bracket round they list, the third-place play-off aside (422 CONTEST_CONFIG_TEMPLATE_ROUND_VALUES_MISMATCH). Setting isDefault unsets the default its sport league and selection type had.

get.description: The sport-event catalog, narrowed by sport, statuses, sport league, Season and name and never paged. At least one of `sport`, `sportLeagueId` and `sportLeagueSeasonId` is required, so the list never reads every event: 400 SPORT_EVENT_FILTER_REQUIRED otherwise. A root admin browses the whole catalog. Any other signed-in user, for contest setup, may list only events in the statuses that can still take a contest (SCHEDULED, POSTPONED, IN_PROGRESS) or one Season's (`sportLeagueSeasonId`): 403 ROOT_ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED otherwise (#1348). Each event carries its loaded field size, contest-setup readiness and tier count; a root admin's list also carries each event's adminCounts. DRAFT events (not yet released for contests) are listed for a root admin only.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only events of this sport.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only events in one of these lifecycle statuses: repeat the parameter for several. Contest setup asks for the statuses an event can still take a contest in.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: Only events of this sport league.

parameters.name: sportLeagueSeasonId
parameters.description: Only events of this Season (SportLeagueSeasonDto).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the event name.

post.summary: Create a test event on a test slot
post.description: A test event (QA only, #2004), DRAFT, on a free test slot of its league's current Season: the sync makes every other event. Its league, Season and dates are the slot's, with its league's tiers, and its rounds are the body's `rounds` in one slot or one in each of several. 404 SEASON_SLOT_NOT_FOUND; 422 SEASON_SLOT_NOT_TEST for a slot the sync keeps, SEASON_SLOT_NOT_CURRENT outside the current Season, EVENT_ROUNDS_FROM_SLOTS for `rounds` with several slots; 409 SEASON_SLOT_TAKEN when it has an event. Root admin only.

get.description: 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND for a DRAFT event unless the caller is a root admin, whose read alone carries adminCounts.

patch.description: Edits any event, linked to a provider or not; a provider never overwrites these fields. A new startDate moves every round by the same amount; a higher rounds count adds rounds, each a day after the one before. 400 SPORT_EVENT_START_NOT_PLACEHOLDER when tellMembers is false and the start being moved is not the noon-UTC date-only placeholder. 422 EVENT_DATES_FROM_SLOTS when startDate or endDate is sent for an event with Season slots, whose dates are its slots'. Root admin only.

delete.description: Deletes the event with its rounds, tiers and field. 409 EVENT_HAS_CONTESTS while any contest runs on it. Root admin only.

post.summary: Release a draft sport event for contests
post.description: DRAFT → SCHEDULED. Commissioners can then see the event and build contests on it, and its tiers and prices are locked for good. Refused unless the field is loaded, every active participant has a tier, every tier has an active participant, and the start time has not passed. An event whose sport plays a bracket also needs its bracket complete (every side of every match named or filled by an earlier winner, every active field member in it, nobody withdrawn left in it), and its seeds lock at release. Root admin only.

409.description: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_DRAFT: the event has already been released. SPORT_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED: its start time has passed.

422.description: SPORT_EVENT_NOT_READY: the field is not loaded, an active participant has no tier, a tier has no active participant, prices are not assigned or miss an active participant, or a bracket event's bracket is incomplete. The rounds, provider-link and contest-setup ready checks hold only the automatic release (#1823).

post.summary: Move a sport event to its next status
post.description: Only to one of the event's allowedTransitions. Starting it activates its contests in the request; finishing or cancelling it queues a background job that settles them, so they reach COMPLETED shortly after this answers. A DRAFT event is refused SCHEDULED with 409 SPORT_EVENT_RELEASE_REQUIRED: releasing it is its own action (releaseEvent). 409 SPORT_EVENT_INVALID_TRANSITION when the event's status changed elsewhere while this request ran (the lifecycle scheduler, another admin) and it did not end in the status asked for. Root admin only.

get.description: Every round by number, each with where it stands (status, result count, completion time) read off the results recorded in it, in a fixed number of reads.

patch.description: Moves existing rounds, all or none; 404 ROUND_NOT_FOUND for a round the event lacks. Root admin only.

get.summary: List the contests on a sport event
get.description: Every customer contest run on the event, across every league, newest first and never paged, with its league, contest template, status and entry count. The root admin's Event page reads it; one read however many contests. Root admin only: 403 ROOT_ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED otherwise. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown event. More than 120 reads a minute from one address answer 429 EVENT_ADMIN_RATE_LIMITED.

200.description: The customer contests on one event.

get.summary: Get an event's syncs, health, issues, release and tier order
get.description: The root admin's Event page header and sync rows (#1889), by the League page's rules applied to one event: its field and scores syncs from its own latest runs, its sync health, its issues (SYNC, RELEASE, OVERDUE), its release mode and date, the value its active field is ordered by for tiers and prices, and each field row's feed id and when a sync last saw it. A fixed number of reads however large the field. Root admin only: 403 ROOT_ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED otherwise. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown event. More than 120 reads a minute from one address answer 429 EVENT_ADMIN_RATE_LIMITED.
Every participant on the field with its canonical participant, valuation, standing and rounds, in seed order.

post.summary: Add participants to a sport event's field
post.description: Any participants; ones already on the field are skipped. 422 TEST_PARTICIPANT_NOT_ON_TEST_SLOT for a test participant on an event the sync keeps: one joins only a test slot's event. Root admin only.

patch.description: Patches field rows, their manual prices and their moves into another tier, all or none. Root admin only. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED when a released event's price or tier would change: its tiers and prices are locked. 409 SPORT_EVENT_SEEDS_LOCKED when a released bracket event's seed would change: the upset bonus reads the seeds as they stood at release. 422 UNKNOWN_TIER_KEY for a tierKey the event has no tier for.

post.summary: Settle an event's contests again
post.description: Queues a rebuild of every leaderboard on the event's contests from the results stored now, and returns at once; the job shows in Activity. Changes no result. For a rebuild that failed or never ran, or after a scoring fix. Root admin only.

post.summary: Reload a sport event's field from its provider
post.description: Queues a provider sync of the field and returns at once; reload the field once the sync runs complete. 409 EVENT_NOT_LINKED for an event with no provider; 422 EVENT_SYNC_KIND_UNAVAILABLE for a postponed or cancelled event, which no field sync runs on (#2238). Root admin only.

202.description: A manual sync submission. The runs execute asynchronously after the request is accepted.

delete.summary: Remove a participant from a sport event's field
delete.description: 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_HAS_PICKS once a contest entry has picked it — withdraw it instead. 409 EVENT_PARTICIPANT_IN_BRACKET while a bracket match names it. Root admin only.

get.summary: List a sport event's field with a slot's valuations
get.description: The field as listEventParticipants reads it, each row's valuation in the slot's set. The set of the slot the event plays in this Season slot (#2044): a slot holds one when a contest of a tiered or budget template may start there (each slot a one-slot or from-slot template lists, the first a whole-event template lists), or it is the event's first slot and no such template lists any.

get.summary: List a sport event slot's tiers
get.description: The set of the slot the event plays in this Season slot (#2044): a slot holds one when a contest of a tiered or budget template may start there (each slot a one-slot or from-slot template lists, the first a whole-event template lists), or it is the event's first slot and no such template lists any. Who is in each tier is on each field row's valuation (listEventSlotParticipants).

put.summary: Replace a sport event slot's tiers
put.description: The slot's optional override of the tiers it copied from its sport league's tier profile. While no tier was placed by hand, the field is placed in the new tiers at once, as auto-assign does. Once one was (MANUAL), places are kept and 409 TIER_REPLACE_WOULD_ORPHAN_ASSIGNMENTS answers a removal that would strand participants with no reassignOrphansTo. The set of the slot the event plays in this Season slot (#2044): a slot holds one when a contest of a tiered or budget template may start there (each slot a one-slot or from-slot template lists, the first a whole-event template lists), or it is the event's first slot and no such template lists any. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the set is locked: the event's tier-set slot (its first slot holding a set) at release, any other slot once it starts. 409 SLOT_HOLDS_NO_TIER_SET for a slot holding no set. Root admin only.

post.summary: Fill a sport event slot's tiers from its active field
post.description: Fills the slot's tiers from the field still active when it starts: a later slot's set leaves out the participants who lost a decided match in an earlier slot. Returns the field with the slot's valuations. 409 FIELD_HAS_NO_ORDER when no active participant has a value for any source the league's tier profile lists: a field is never ordered by name. 422 TIER_SIZE_NOT_FOR_RANGES when a tier size is sent for a league whose tier profile is RANGES. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the set is locked: the event's tier-set slot (its first slot holding a set) at release, any other slot once it starts. 409 SLOT_HOLDS_NO_TIER_SET for a slot holding no set. Root admin only.

put.summary: Replace a sport event slot's tier assignments
put.description: The drag-and-drop save of the slot's set, all or none. Returns the field with the slot's valuations. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the set is locked: the event's tier-set slot (its first slot holding a set) at release, any other slot once it starts. 409 SLOT_HOLDS_NO_TIER_SET for a slot holding no set. Root admin only.

post.summary: Price a sport event slot's seeded field
post.description: Prices the slot's active field on the budget curve with the values sent, in the order of the league's pricing profile's sources, and stores the values as the slot's pricing, with the profile they started from by id. Repeatable until the set locks. Returns the field with the slot's valuations. 422 PRICING_CONFIG_INVALID when the floor share is above the top share or the rounding unit is above the worst golfer's price (salaryCap × floorSharePercent / 100), which could round prices to $0. 409 FIELD_HAS_NO_ORDER when no active participant has a value for any source the league's pricing profile lists: a field is never ordered by name. 404 PLATFORM_PRICING_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND when no pricing profile has the id sent. 409 SPORT_EVENT_TIERS_LOCKED once the set is locked: the event's tier-set slot (its first slot holding a set) at release, any other slot once it starts. 409 SLOT_HOLDS_NO_TIER_SET for a slot holding no set. Root admin only.

get.summary: Preview a sport event slot's prices
get.description: What pricing the slot's active field with the values sent would charge its best and worst participant, on the curve autoAssignEventSlotPrices uses (#2107). A read: nothing is written, so a locked set may be previewed. 422 PRICING_CONFIG_INVALID for values the assignment would refuse. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND or SPORT_EVENT_SLOT_NOT_FOUND. The set of the slot the event plays in this Season slot (#2044): a slot holds one when a contest of a tiered or budget template may start there (each slot a one-slot or from-slot template lists, the first a whole-event template lists), or it is the event's first slot and no such template lists any. 409 SLOT_HOLDS_NO_TIER_SET for a slot holding no set. Root admin only.

parameters.name: salaryCap
parameters.description: Whole dollars. The salary cap the prices are a share of, and the cap of every budget contest on the event.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Whole dollars. Every price is rounded to a multiple of it. At most the worst golfer's price.

parameters.name: topSharePercent
parameters.description: The best seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap.

parameters.name: floorSharePercent
parameters.description: The worst seed's price, as a percentage of the salary cap. At most `topSharePercent`.

parameters.name: steepness
parameters.description: How fast prices fall from the top: 1 is a straight line; higher keeps the top few expensive and drops the middle of the field towards the floor.

200.description: What pricing a slot's active field with the values sent would charge its best and worst participant (#2107). Nothing is written.

post.summary: Preview a round of golf scores
post.description: Resolves each row against the event's field and reports what it would change. Writes nothing. 422 ROUND_BEYOND_SCHEDULE when the round is beyond the event's scheduled rounds. 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by golf rounds (its scoring family is not stroke play). Root admin only.

200.description: A dry run of a golf score upload. Nothing is written.

post.summary: Apply a round of golf scores
post.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. All or none; 422 ROUND_SCORE_ROWS_UNRESOLVED when any row does not resolve. 422 ROUND_THRU_BEYOND_HOLES when a row's holes completed are more than the round has (its slot's period count). 422 ROUND_BEYOND_SCHEDULE when the round is beyond the event's scheduled rounds. 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by golf rounds (its scoring family is not stroke play). Refreshes standings. Returns the field. Root admin only.

patch.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Stores each value exactly as sent and derives none from another; omitted values keep what is stored. 422 ROUND_THRU_BEYOND_HOLES when thru is more than the round's holes (its slot's period count). 422 ROUND_BEYOND_SCHEDULE when the round is beyond the event's scheduled rounds. 422 ROUND_VALUES_REQUIRED when the golfer has no stored round and the body omits strokes or scoreToPar; the server fills in neither. 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by golf rounds (its scoring family is not stroke play). Refreshes standings. Root admin only.

post.summary: Preview a race result
post.description: Resolves each row against the event's field and reports what applying it would change, with each row's error and the order's as a whole. Writes nothing. 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by finishing place (its scoring family is not finish position). Root admin only.

200.description: A dry run of a race result. Nothing is written.

put.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Stores each runner's result exactly as sent, all or none; runners not named keep theirs. The official flag is set on every result of the race. Writes each runner's standing: its place (a dead heat sharing one, shown "T2"), COMPLETE once it started, WITHDRAWN when it did not start. 422 RACE_RESULT_ROWS_INVALID when a row does not resolve to one runner or carries a row error; 422 RACE_RESULT_POSITIONS_INVALID when the places do not run 1, 2, 3 ... (a dead heat repeats a place and skips the next); 422 RACE_RESULT_FIELD_INCOMPLETE when an official result leaves an active runner without a result or a finisher without a place; 422 EVENT_SCORING_FAMILY_MISMATCH when the event's sport is not scored by finishing place. Returns the field. Root admin only.

get.description: Every match of the event in match-number order, empty until the bracket is loaded. Any signed-in user may read a released event's bracket; a DRAFT event's is a root admin's only. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket.

put.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Replaces every match of the event with the matches sent, all or none. A side may be left empty while its team is not known; release needs the bracket complete. 409 SPORT_EVENT_BRACKET_LOCKED once the event is released. 422 BRACKET_INVALID, naming every problem, when a match number repeats within a round, a round is not the event's, a side names a field row the event lacks or one already named, a winner advances to a match that is missing or not in a later round or to a side that names a team or that another match fills, or there is not exactly one final in the last round. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

get.summary: List the games a squares contest can be played on
get.description: The event's Games a squares contest can be played on now: each a Game of a slot that takes squares, still to kick off, with no period score in, the final's first, then by kickoff. Create contest lists them, and creating a squares contest accepts only one of them. Any signed-in user may read a released event's; a DRAFT event's are a root admin's only. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket.

200.description: The Games of an event a squares contest can be played on.

get.summary: List a sport event's slot tiebreaker games
get.description: Each slot the event covers, with its tiebreaker game (#2048): the one Game whose combined score every contest covering the slot guesses, chosen by the rule (the latest scheduled start, ties to the lower Game id) or by a root admin, and every Game played in the slot with whether it can be chosen now. A fixed number of reads however many slots and Games. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND. Root admin only.

put.description: A root admin chooses which of the slot's Games every contest covering it guesses the combined score of (#2048), on a synced or a test event alike. The choice and who made it are kept and logged, and the rule leaves it alone until it starts; a cancelled or moved game is replaced by the rule's choice with a finding. Choosing the game already chosen records the choice. 404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND, and SEASON_SLOT_NOT_FOUND for a slot the event does not cover. 422 TIEBREAKER_GAME_NOT_IN_SLOT for a Game played elsewhere, TIEBREAKER_GAME_NOT_ELIGIBLE for one cancelled, moved or with no start. 409 TIEBREAKER_GAME_STARTED once the slot's game, or the one asked for, has started. Root admin only.

patch.summary: Edit one match of a sport event's bracket
patch.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Values left out keep what is stored. The time and site can change at any point; the sides only until release (409 SPORT_EVENT_BRACKET_LOCKED). The home spread can change until release, and after it only while no entry has picked the game (409 MATCH_SPREAD_LOCKED), and never cleared (422 MATCH_SPREAD_REQUIRED). 422 BRACKET_INVALID when a side would name a field row the event lacks or one another match names, a side an earlier match's winner fills, or both sides one team. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND for a round and match number the bracket lacks. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Root admin only.

200.description: One match of an event's bracket.

put.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Completes the match with its winner and scores, puts the winner on the side of the match it advances to, and rewrites every team's event standing from the bracket (the champion 1, a team that lost ELIMINATED). A week of games that forms no bracket ranks no team: a team is COMPLETE once its game is played or cancelled. A game of such a week can end in a tie (#792): a null winnerSideNumber with each side's score level. Re-sending a match's result changes it. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 422 MATCH_SIDES_NOT_SET while a side waits for an earlier winner. A bracket match level after extra time, in a sport settled by shoot-out, takes both shoot-out scores and the winner's is the higher; they are kept apart from the match score. A match that ended early says how (ending): after a RETIREMENT or DEFAULT the winner's score may be the lower, and a WALKOVER has no scores; its winner wins in full. 422 MATCH_RESULT_INVALID for one score without the other, a winner without the higher score in a match played to its end, a tie without level scores, a tie in a bracket match, shoot-out scores on a match that is not a level bracket match of such a sport, a tie or shoot-out that ended early, or a walkover with scores or period scores. 409 SPORT_EVENT_ROUND_MATCH_RESULT_LOCKED once the match its winner advanced to has a result or a period score. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

put.summary: Enter a game's score at the end of a period
put.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Both sides' score at the end of one period before the last (the end of the first, second or third quarter in American football), as the scoreboard shows it. It can be entered while the game is played and corrected after it; re-sending it changes it. Squares pools read it. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 MATCH_CANCELLED for a cancelled game. 422 MATCH_PERIOD_INVALID when the event's sport keeps no score by period, or for the last period or past it, whose score is the final result. 422 MATCH_SIDES_NOT_SET while a side waits for its team. 422 MATCH_PERIOD_SCORE_INVALID when a side's score is below its score at an earlier period's end, or above its score at a later one's or its final score, and for a game that was a walkover. 422 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_BRACKET when the event's sport is not played as a bracket. Returns the bracket. Root admin only.

post.summary: Cancel a game
post.description: Test events only (#2074): an event that covers no test slot takes its results from the feed alone, 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_TEST_DATA. Calls off an unplayed game of a released week whose games form no bracket, such as a postponed NFL game: it counts for nothing in any contest, and is added to the week it moves to while that week is a draft. Cancelling a cancelled game changes nothing. 409 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_RELEASED for a draft, whose games are edited freely. 404 BRACKET_MATCH_NOT_FOUND. 409 MATCH_ALREADY_PLAYED for a game with a result. 422 MATCH_IN_BRACKET for a game of a bracket, which cannot lose one. Returns the games. Root admin only.

get.description: For a league that reseeds (the NFL after Wild Card weekend): in each region the best seed left hosts the worst and the second best the second worst; a bye or a linked winner keeps its place. Root admin only.

post.description: Takes one of the finding's offered actions: RESOLVE, WAIVE with a note, or REOPEN (#1999). 404 SYNC_FINDING_NOT_FOUND. 409 SYNC_FINDING_ACTION_NOT_OFFERED when the finding does not offer the action now. 422 SYNC_FINDING_WAIVE_NOTE_REQUIRED for WAIVE with no note. More than 60 requests a minute from one address answer 429 SYNC_FINDINGS_RATE_LIMITED.

parameters.description: The finding (ProviderSyncFindingDto.id).

post.description: An OPEN UNMAPPED_PARTICIPANT finding's fix (#1999): maps the feed's participant id (providerValue) from its Provider to a participant of its sport league, as bindParticipantProviderMapping does, and resolves the finding. 404 SYNC_FINDING_NOT_FOUND or PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND. 409 SYNC_FINDING_ACTION_NOT_OFFERED when the finding does not offer MAP_PARTICIPANT now. 422 SYNC_FINDING_PARTICIPANT_OTHER_LEAGUE for a participant of another league. More than 60 requests a minute from one address answer 429 SYNC_FINDINGS_RATE_LIMITED.

get.description: What an OPEN SLOT_NAME_UNMATCHED finding's "link to existing" offers (#2011): every slot definition its sport league matches tournaments to by name through its mapping to the finding's Provider, by key, each with the names that already place a tournament on it. Read in a fixed number of queries. 404 SYNC_FINDING_NOT_FOUND. 409 SYNC_FINDING_ACTION_NOT_OFFERED when the finding does not offer LINK_SLOT now. More than 60 requests a minute from one address answer 429 SYNC_FINDINGS_RATE_LIMITED.

There is no "create new": slot definitions are set by migration. 404 SYNC_FINDING_NOT_FOUND, or SLOT_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND for a slot listProviderSyncFindingSlotChoices does not offer. 409 SYNC_FINDING_ACTION_NOT_OFFERED when the finding does not offer LINK_SLOT now, or SLOT_NAME_PATTERN_TAKEN when the name already places a tournament. More than 60 requests a minute from one address answer 429 SYNC_FINDINGS_RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: List background jobs for the Activity grid
get.description: Every background job queued inside a window (syncs, emails, settlements, releases and the rest), filtered by kind, status, sport league and event, newest first. Nothing pages the result; the filters narrow it. `to` defaults to now; `from` to 24 hours before it, or to 30 days before it (every job kept) when a sportLeagueId or sportEventId narrows the read. A `from` after `to` answers 400 ACTIVITY_WINDOW_INVALID; more than 60 reads a minute from one address answer 429 ACTIVITY_RATE_LIMITED. A league's activity is its own jobs and the jobs on any of its events. Each sync job names the sync runs it ran; read one with getProviderSyncRun.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: What a job is about: a provider SYNC, EMAIL to a league, contest SETTLEMENT, an event's RELEASE, or OTHER.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: QUEUED waits for its run time, RUNNING is claimed, SUCCEEDED finished, FAILED will not run again.

parameters.name: sportLeagueId
parameters.description: The league's own jobs and the jobs on any of its events.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest queue time to include. Defaults to 24 hours before `to`, or with a sportLeagueId or sportEventId, to 30 days before it: every job kept.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest queue time to include. Defaults to now.

200.description: The jobs queued inside the window that match the filters, newest first.

get.summary: List every league for the Customers grid
get.description: Every league on the platform, active or not, by name: never paged and never searched on the server, since the grid filters on the client. Each row carries its plan, owner (its longest-serving active commissioner), active member and open-or-live contest counts, and when its Premium preview ends. Read from four queries, however many leagues. Change the plan with updateLeaguePlan and the preview with extendLeaguePlanRenewal. Root admin only. More than 60 reads a minute from one address answer 429 CUSTOMERS_RATE_LIMITED.

200.description: Every league on the platform, for the Customers › Leagues grid.

get.summary: List every user for the Customers grid
get.description: Every user on the platform, active or not, by last then first name: never paged and never searched on the server, since the grid filters on the client. Each row carries its role, status, the leagues it is an active member of, when it joined and when it last signed in. Read from two queries, however many users. Change the name with updateUserProfile and the role with setUserRootAdmin. Root admin only. More than 60 reads a minute from one address answer 429 CUSTOMERS_RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: Ingest browser log batches for operational diagnostics
post.description: Accepts browser-produced structured log batches so webapp runtime events can be correlated with backend request logs in operational tooling.

post.summary: Receive a BALLDONTLIE webhook notification
post.description: Public; called by BALLDONTLIE, never by the app. The delivery must carry X-BDL-Webhook-Timestamp (Unix seconds, within 5 minutes of now) and X-BDL-Webhook-Signature (`v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `{timestamp}.{body}` under this environment's endpoint secret; several, separated by commas or spaces, while the secret rotates, any one of which may match), or the answer is 403 PROVIDER_WEBHOOK_UNVERIFIED, as it is for every delivery while the provider's webhooks are off: switched off on the Providers page, or no secret configured. A verified notification about a game or tournament linked to an in-progress event queues one live-score sync of that event, due about a minute later; notifications arriving while it waits queue nothing more. The sync reads the provider's current scores, so the notification's own contents are never written. A notification about nothing linked, or of a type PoolMaster does not act on for any of the provider's enabled leagues, is acknowledged and dropped. Every verified delivery answers 200, so the provider does not retry it.

post.summary: Receive an SES delivery event from SNS
post.description: Public; called by Amazon SNS, never by the app. The message must come from this environment's SES events topic and carry a valid SNS signature from a certificate on the sns.<region>.amazonaws.com host of the topic's region, and be at most an hour old, or the answer is 403 EMAIL_EVENT_UNVERIFIED. A subscription confirmation is confirmed. A notification carries one SES event: a delivery marks the email DELIVERED; a permanent bounce marks it BOUNCED and a complaint COMPLAINED, and both stop the app from emailing that address again; a rejection marks it FAILED. A transient bounce changes nothing. An event for an email this environment did not send changes no email's status, though a permanent bounce or complaint still stops the app from emailing that address. Both still answer 200, so SNS does not retry them.

post.summary: Unsubscribe from one category of email by its link
post.description: Public; the token from an email's "Stop these emails" link or List-Unsubscribe header is its whole authority. It turns off the category of email the token names for the user it names, the same switch as on their account. Repeating it changes nothing. A token this app did not issue, or one for an account since deleted, is 400 EMAIL_UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_INVALID.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the email's unsubscribe link.

200.description: The category the unsubscribe link turned off.

get.summary: Get current selection state for a contest
get.description: Returns the current selection-room state for one event of the contest (#713): `sportEventId`, else its next event that has not started, else its last; 404 CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST for an event the contest does not cover. It includes the event's field, its picks, and each entry's status in it. A budget contest lists the whole field as one group, dearest first, and carries `lineupSummary`: the viewed entry's spend against the salary cap. Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. A DRAFT contest answers 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND to anyone but its league's commissioners and root admins. Until the event's picks are revealed (the contest is live and the event has started, or a random draw has dealt) the pick history carries only the caller's own entries, and entryId selects another squad's entry only once they are; otherwise it falls back to the caller's own. 409 CONTEST_EVENT_REQUIRED for a contest that covers no event.

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: Specific contest entry to view within roster-based selection flows.

parameters.name: sportEventId
parameters.description: The contest event whose picks to show (#713). Defaults to the contest's next event that has not started, else its last event.

put.description: Selects one field row for the entry, in the event the row belongs to (#713, #1259). Selecting a row the entry already holds changes nothing. In a tiered contest a pick in a full tier replaces the tier's newest pick. In a budget contest a golfer with no price is refused with 400 PRICE_MISSING, a full roster with 400 ENTRY_COMPLETE, and the salary cap never refuses a pick: an entry may go over it while it rearranges. A withdrawn or otherwise unavailable row is refused with 400 PARTICIPANT_UNAVAILABLE. Picks are placed, swapped and unselected only while the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and the pick's event has not started: 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise, and 409 SELECTION_DEALT_BY_DRAW in a random-draw contest, whose picks the draw deals. Only a member of the entry's squad may change its picks: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND for an entry not in the contest; 400 PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_EVENT or PARTICIPANT_NOT_SELECTABLE for a field row outside the contest's events. A change that leaves a SUBMITTED entry's lineup short, or over a budget contest's cap, sends the entry back to DRAFT for that event; it must be submitted again to count. The answer carries only what changed on the entry (#1259): its picks in the event, its status there and, in a budget contest, its lineup summary.

200.description: What one pick change left on the entry (#1259): only what changed, for the room to merge into what it shows. Never the whole room.

delete.description: Removes one field row from the entry's picks (#1259). Unselecting a row the entry does not hold changes nothing. A golfer who withdrew after being picked can still be removed. Picks are placed, swapped and unselected only while the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and the pick's event has not started: 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise, and 409 SELECTION_DEALT_BY_DRAW in a random-draw contest, whose picks the draw deals. Only a member of the entry's squad may change its picks: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND for an entry not in the contest; 400 PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_EVENT or PARTICIPANT_NOT_SELECTABLE for a field row outside the contest's events. A change that leaves a SUBMITTED entry's lineup short, or over a budget contest's cap, sends the entry back to DRAFT for that event; it must be submitted again to count. The answer carries only what changed on the entry (#1259): its picks in the event, its status there and, in a budget contest, its lineup summary.

200.description: What one pick change left on the entry (#1259): only what changed, for the room to merge into what it shows. Never the whole room.

post.summary: Submit a contest entry's picks for one event
post.description: Submits the caller's entry for one event of its contest (#713: "submit week 6", "submit your Masters picks") once that event's lineup is complete, and returns the refreshed selection state for that event. Each event of an entry starts as DRAFT and counts nowhere (leaderboard, standings, settlement, entry counts) until it is SUBMITTED. The lineup must hold the full roster with exactly each tier's picks: 409 ENTRY_LINEUP_INCOMPLETE otherwise. In a budget contest its picks must also cost no more than the salary cap: 409 ENTRY_OVER_BUDGET otherwise, reported only once the lineup is complete. Submitting an already submitted event changes nothing. A later pick change that leaves the lineup short or over the cap sends that event back to DRAFT. An event is submitted only while the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and that event's start time has not passed: 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST for an event the contest does not cover. Only a member of the entry's squad may submit it: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise.

get.summary: Get a prediction contest entry's game picks for one event
get.description: Returns one event's games, in game-number order and without cancelled games, with the entry's pick on each (#716). Active members of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED or LEAGUE_MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE otherwise. The entry's own squad sees every pick; anyone else sees a pick only once its game is revealed, at that game's kickoff once the contest is live (in a bracket, every pick at the event's start). Each game carries its sides (#2016), each with where it plays, the team really playing on it and the team the entry's own picks put there (`predictedTeam`): in a bracket (#721) a later game offers the teams the entry picked to win the games before it, paired by seed in a reseeded round. A bracket's picks also carry their outcome (CORRECT, BUSTED or PENDING) and points, and the entry its points, the most it can still reach, and its tiebreaker. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

put.description: Saves the caller's picks on one event's games, all or none, and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Each pick names a game and the team picked to win, or in a pick'em pool whose sport offers it (`tiePicksOffered`) a tie (#792), and replaces the entry's pick on that game. In a bracket (#721) a pick must name a team the entry's picks put in the game (picks earlier in the same request count), and a later pick that no longer follows from them is cleared; the request may also set the event's `tiebreakerValue`, the total points of its tiebreaker game, a bracket's final or a week's last game (#717; 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED once that game's pick has locked). A bracket's every pick locks at the event's start. Only a member of the entry's squad may save: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. Refused with 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED unless the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE, and once the event's first game has started for a week still in draft (it doesn't count); 404 PREDICTION_GAME_NOT_FOUND for a game not in the event; 409 PREDICTION_GAME_STARTED once a game has kicked off; 400 PREDICTION_TEAM_NOT_IN_GAME for a team the game does not offer the entry; 400 PREDICTION_PICK_INVALID for a TEAM pick without its team or a TIE pick with one; 422 PREDICTION_TIE_NOT_OFFERED for a tie pick in a pool that takes none; 409 PREDICTION_CONFIDENCE_INVALID for a confidence value in a straight-up pool, outside 1 to the week's game count, or, after the first kickoff, leaving a submitted week's values repeated. A value may repeat until the week is submitted. Before the first kickoff, a change that leaves a submitted week's confidence values invalid sends it back to DRAFT. In a survivor contest (#719): 409 PREDICTION_ONE_PICK_REQUIRED unless the week holds exactly one pick; 409 PREDICTION_TEAM_ALREADY_USED for a team the entry picked in another submitted week; 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. On a playoff bracket (#785) each round is a week: the event is submitted once with its first round's one pick, each later round holds at most one pick (a new one replaces the entry's pick in that round), no team is picked in two rounds, and an entry out in one round picks no later round. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

delete.description: Removes the caller's pick on one game and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Clearing a game with no pick changes nothing. In a bracket the later picks that followed from it are cleared too (#721). Before the event's first kickoff, clearing a pick of a submitted week sends it back to DRAFT. Refused as saving is, and with 409 PREDICTION_CLEAR_AFTER_FIRST_KICKOFF once the first game has started: a submitted week then stays submitted, and a pick on a game still to start can be changed to the other team but not cleared. In a survivor contest (#719), 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

post.summary: Submit an entry's game picks for one event
post.description: Submits the caller's entry for one event ("submit week 6") and returns the event's games with the entry's picks (#716). Only a submitted event counts. Every game must be picked: 409 PREDICTION_WEEK_INCOMPLETE otherwise. In a confidence pool the values must be 1 to the game count, each used once: 409 PREDICTION_CONFIDENCE_INVALID otherwise. Every event needs its tiebreaker, a bracket's (#721) and a pick'em week's (#717): 409 PREDICTION_TIEBREAKER_MISSING otherwise. Submitting a submitted event changes nothing. Refused with 409 CONTEST_ENTRY_LOCKED unless the contest is OPEN or ACTIVE and the event's first game has not started. Only a member of the entry's team may submit: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. In a survivor contest (#719): 409 PREDICTION_ONE_PICK_REQUIRED unless the week holds exactly one pick; 409 PREDICTION_TEAM_ALREADY_USED for a team the entry picked in another submitted week; 409 PREDICTION_ENTRY_ELIMINATED once the entry is out. On a playoff bracket (#785) each round is a week: the event is submitted once with its first round's one pick, each later round holds at most one pick (a new one replaces the entry's pick in that round), no team is picked in two rounds, and an entry out in one round picks no later round. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND, CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_IN_CONTEST or CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a roster contest, whose entries pick a lineup through the selection room.

200.description: A prediction contest entry's picks on one event's games.

post.summary: Run a random draw
post.description: Runs a random-draw contest's draw and returns the refreshed selection state. Commissioner of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 otherwise. The draw shuffles the event's available field and deals it round-robin, so every entry gets the contest's picksPerEntry; field members left over are not dealt. Every entry is submitted, entries close (no entering, leaving or renaming), and every entry's picks are visible to the league from then on. Final: there is no undo or redraw. The seed and dealt order are kept so the draw can be replayed. 409 CONTEST_NOT_RANDOM_DRAW for another selection type, CONTEST_DRAW_ALREADY_RUN once drawn, CONTEST_DRAW_NOT_OPEN unless the contest is OPEN, CONTEST_EVENT_ALREADY_STARTED once its event's start time has passed, CONTEST_DRAW_NO_ENTRIES with no entries, CONTEST_DRAW_FIELD_TOO_SMALL when the available field cannot deal every entry its picks, CONTEST_DRAW_ENTRIES_CHANGED when an entry came or went while the draw ran (nothing is dealt; run it again).

get.description: The grid of a squares contest (#711): each claimed box and its entry, the digits once drawn, the game with its score at the end of each period and its final result, each scoring moment's winning box (frozen once the contest is Final), and each entry's boxes and wins. Any member of the contest's league may read it. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

put.summary: Claim a box of a squares grid
put.description: Claims an empty box for an entry and returns the grid. A member claims for their own squad's entry; the commissioner (or a root admin) for any entry: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 CONTEST_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND for an entry not in the contest. 409 SQUARES_CLAIMING_CLOSED unless the contest is OPEN, its numbers are not drawn and its game has not kicked off; SQUARES_BOX_TAKEN when someone holds the box; SQUARES_BOX_LIMIT_REACHED when the entry holds the contest's box limit. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

delete.summary: Clear a box of a squares grid
delete.description: Clears a claimed box and returns the grid. Its holder's squad may clear it, and the commissioner (or a root admin) any box: 403 ENTRY_ACCESS_DENIED otherwise. 404 SQUARES_BOX_NOT_CLAIMED when nobody holds it. 409 SQUARES_CLAIMING_CLOSED under the same window as claiming. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

post.summary: Draw a squares contest's numbers
post.description: Draws the digits 0 to 9 along each side of the grid, at random, and returns the grid. Commissioner of the contest's league only (root admins bypass): 403 otherwise. Claiming closes for good; every entry holding a box is submitted, and boxes nobody claimed stay empty. The seed is kept so the draw can be replayed. 409 SQUARES_ALREADY_DRAWN once drawn; SQUARES_DRAW_CLOSED unless the contest is OPEN or live and the game's first period score is not entered. 404 CONTEST_NOT_FOUND (a draft is shown only to its commissioners); 409 CONTEST_FORMAT_MISMATCH for a contest that is not squares.

post.summary: Preview a roster setup's pick screen
post.description: The pick screen a tiered or budget setup gives members, from the setup's rules as the form holds them, unsaved, and the event's real field, tiers and prices: the field grouped as the rules group it, with the trial picks marked, whether they make a lineup an entry could submit, and a budget setup's spend against the event's salary cap. It writes nothing: no contest, entry or pick is created, and the trial picks are only read back. Commissioners of the league only (root admins bypass). 404 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown event; 400 PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_EVENT for a trial pick outside its field; 409 CONTEST_EVENT_NOT_PRICED for a budget setup on an event whose field was never priced.

200.description: A roster setup's pick screen as members would see it, with the trial picks on it. Nothing is saved.

post.summary: Preview a game setup's pick screen
post.description: The pick screen a pick'em, bracket or survivor setup gives members, from the setup's rules as the form holds them, unsaved, and the event's real games and lines: the games an entry would pick, each locked as it would be once the contest opens, with the trial picks resolved as an entry's would be. A bracket's later games hold the teams the earlier trial picks put there, and a trial pick that no longer follows, or a tie pick the setup does not offer, is dropped, and so is a confidence value the setup's mode does not take (a saved entry is refused for one instead). It writes nothing: no contest, entry or pick is created, and the trial picks are only read back. Commissioners of the league only (root admins bypass). 404 SPORT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown event; 404 PREDICTION_GAME_NOT_FOUND for a trial pick on a game the setup does not pick; 400 PREDICTION_PICK_INVALID for a TEAM pick without its team or a TIE pick with one.

200.description: A game setup's pick screen as members would see it, with the trial picks on it. Nothing is saved.
